authority_basis.summary: After deriving the global Euler operator and analytic completion, determine in what verified sense the global construction contains zeta zeros.

operations.title: Zeta zeros are poles of the continued intrinsic prime-power trace
operations.statement: For Re(s)>1, T_P(s)=sum_(p,k)(log p)p^(-ks)=-zeta'(s)/zeta(s) is the logarithmic trace of the intrinsic-prime Fredholm determinant. Theta completion gives xi'/xi equal to explicit archimedean terms minus T_P. Hadamard factorization expresses xi'/xi as a sum of simple zero poles, so the meromorphically continued prime trace has poles at zeta zeros with negative multiplicity residues. This is a resonance interpretation, not a self-adjoint eigenvalue theorem.
operations.scope: Conditional on intrinsic pi_0 primes and explicit archimedean theta/complex-analysis input; no Riemann hypothesis or Hilbert-Polya operator.

operations.title: Logarithmic-trace pole matching test
operations.procedure: Differentiate the completed xi definition, substitute the prime-power series for -zeta'/zeta in Re(s)>1, continue through theta completion, and compare with the order-one Hadamard logarithmic derivative.
operations.expected_result: Every xi zero of multiplicity m gives residue m in xi'/xi and residue -m in the continued prime trace after archimedean separation. Any unmatched pole or residue falsifies the bridge.
